title: Clockwork Sorceress
description: A female figure with pale skin, red eyes and dark hair in a topknot stands centrally, holding a large purple hammer in her right hand while her left arm is a skeletal limb fused with a glowing green scarab beetle. Blue and orange electrical energy crackles around her, dripping from the hammer and her left eye.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a mysterious woman with red eyes and topknot hair wearing flowing purple robes, her left arm replaced by a skeletal limb ending in a large glowing green scarab beetle. She holds a massive ornate purple hammer crackling with orange and blue energy. Behind her is a giant melting clock face with Roman numerals surrounded by magical symbols, floating skeletons, and glowing insects against a dark cosmic background with lightning.
